title: Zero-Allocation Search
goal: Pick the implementation that searches a string list without cloning strings.
hints: Returning Option<&str> allows borrowing directly from the input slice.
Converting or cloning strings inside the loop creates temporary values that cannot be returned by reference.
explanation: Returning `Option<&'a str>` allows borrowing a view into the input slice with zero heap allocations. Cloning the item or calling `to_string()` creates a local variable inside the loop. Returning a reference to a local variable triggers `E0515` because the local value is dropped when the function returns.
